title: AdminPickaxe
description: An ultimate administrative tool forged with 100,000 efficiency. Strikes any player to instantly kick them from the server.
body:
**### Admin Pickaxe (Kick on Hit)**
Admin Pickaxe is a powerful administrative utility mod designed for server owners and moderators. It introduces a specialized tool that helps manage your server directly through gameplay.
🌟 Key Features:
Instant Kick on Hit: Strike any player with this pickaxe to instantly disconnect them from the server.
Extreme Stats: Features an incredible 100,000 efficiency speed and matching durability, making it the ultimate tool for creative or administrative tasks.
Epic Rarity & Fire Resistance: Built to survive lava, fire, and explosions, ensuring you never lose your management tool.
Server-Safe: The custom kick logic runs strictly on the server side to prevent client crashes and ensure smooth performance.
⚙️ Technical Specifications:
Platform: NeoForge
Minecraft Version: 1.21.8
Environment: Works on both Client and Server (Required on the server side for the kick functionality to work).
🛑 Important Note:
This tool is intended for server administration purposes only. Please ensure that only trusted players with operator (OP) status or appropriate permissions have access to this item in-game.
